title: Hermite function
statement: Let $n\ge 0$, let $\alpha$ assign a nonnegative integer to each of the $n$ coordinates, and let $x\in\mathbb R^n$. The Hermite function indexed by $\alpha$ is the value at $x$ of the multivariate Hermite polynomial indexed by $\alpha$.
hypotheses_covered: $\alpha$ assigns a natural number to each of the $n$ coordinates
$x$ is a real vector with $n$ coordinates
